Privacy policy

Watchlists, price targets, display preferences and browser-alert history are stored locally on the visitor's device. The site does not receive those values through its own server.

Third-party services

Embedded market widgets and external data providers may process technical information such as IP address, browser information and requested symbols under their own policies. The current build includes TradingView widgets, Stooq-derived market data, CoinGecko market data and an exchange-rate endpoint.

Analytics and advertising

Analytics does not load unless the publisher configures it and the visitor accepts the consent prompt. If advertising or additional analytics is introduced, this policy and the consent mechanism must be updated before launch.

Contact

For privacy questions or data requests, contact onlineadmin00@gmail.com.
